issues.title: Queue counter delay
issues.scope: Queue counts may trail new or reassigned work by up to 12 minutes.
issues.workaround: Refresh the queue or use filtered ticket search to confirm the current workload.
issues.validation: Compare queue totals with filtered search after a 15-minute observation window.

issues.title: CSV import retry
issues.scope: Some CSV imports stop after a temporary validation timeout.
issues.workaround: Correct quoted-field errors, wait 10 minutes, then retry the same file once.
issues.validation: Confirm a completion banner and sample three imported records.

issues.title: Session timeout
issues.scope: Long-running inactive browser tabs can ask users to sign in earlier than expected.
issues.workaround: Save draft work, refresh the tab, and sign in again before continuing.
issues.validation: Verify the saved draft remains available after re-authentication.

issues.title: Notification lag
issues.scope: Email and in-app notifications can arrive later than their related ticket event.
issues.workaround: Open the ticket activity feed for the latest state; do not repeat the action solely because a notice is delayed.
issues.validation: Match the activity timestamp to the eventually delivered notice.
